results.name: The shipped spatial service declares four exact revisions and a separate read-only interface
Malformed, non-iNES and over-limit inputs cannot enter spatial decoding
Filename-like unknown bytes do not authorize native scene, collision or animation claims
Source inspection copies input and preserves the project, emulator, Undo and download state
The bundled file workflow displays an explicit unknown result and a source-scoped export
A failed file replacement clears the prior report and cannot export stale evidence
A newer file selection wins when an earlier file read completes late
Returned exports are detached and cannot change staged source identity or limits
Selecting no file clears staged data and stops animation state
The new RE panel owns text key events without preventing default field editing
